title: FEEDBACK
body: Found a bug? Something broken, missing, or an idea? Describe it below and it goes straight to the app maker. More detail is better.
placeholder: What can we improve? Bug, idea, anything.

merge.title: DUPLICATE
merge.explainer: Pick the other game that looks like the same one. We'll review — this does not merge immediately.
merge.notePlaceholder: e.g. same covers / same Discord server
merge.emptyList: No other games in the library.

merge.thanksMessage: We'll review and merge if it's the same game.
